added_requirement_surfaces.text: Beacon must close the four accepted friction findings with the lowest-cognitive-load route: keep `truth-cutover` as a CLI/machine repair transaction instead of adding a new default public skill, route existing human surfaces to it, add explicit `doctor truth-source-mismatch` diagnostics and repair commands, and regression-test the `technical_review_contract` root fix plus change CLI version stability.
added_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::friction-routing-simplification::beacon must close the four accepted friction findings with the lowest-cognitive-load route: keep `truth-cutover` as a cli/machine repair transaction instead of adding a new default public skill, route existing human surfaces to it, add explicit `doctor truth-source-mismatch` diagnostics and repair commands, and regression-test the `technical_review_contract` root fix plus change cli version stability.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Freeze, refreeze, implement, QA, and release must fail closed while package authority, governance MD, or agent-surface verification is incomplete or contradictory.

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Project governance cutover must verify `docs/beacon/governance/project-version-governance.md` and generated sqlite/runtime projection, failing closed on missing version contract or projection drift.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::governance-verify::project governance cutover must verify `docs/beacon/governance/project-version-governance.md` and generated sqlite/runtime projection, failing closed on missing version contract or projection drift.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Cutover preflight detects legacy or mixed truth state, including old `prd/`, `user-story/`, `qa/test-cases/` surfaces, missing feature package files, missing governance MD, missing projection, and stale agent-surface guidance.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::legacy-detection::cutover preflight detects legacy or mixed truth state, including old `prd/`, `user-story/`, `qa/test-cases/` surfaces, missing feature package files, missing governance md, missing projection, and stale agent-surface guidance.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Requirement package cutover must validate `features/<slug>/{truth,tests,tasks,evidence}.md` as v1.5.2 package authority; legacy triptych can be absorb/rebuild/archive-only and cannot win authority.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::package-authority::requirement package cutover must validate `features/<slug>/{truth,tests,tasks,evidence}.md` as v1.5.2 package authority; legacy triptych can be absorb/rebuild/archive-only and cannot win authority.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Beacon exposes a human-facing one-command cutover wrapper that runs or reports phases: inventory, package materialize/validate, truth-map verify, governance verify/projection, agent-surface refresh, and resume.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::phased-migration::beacon exposes a human-facing one-command cutover wrapper that runs or reports phases: inventory, package materialize/validate, truth-map verify, governance verify/projection, agent-surface refresh, and resume.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: `beacon-change-refreeze` must detect legacy/mixed state before refreeze and route to cutover instead of presenting `beacon change ... --refreeze-chain` as sufficient.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::refreeze-intercept::`beacon-change-refreeze` must detect legacy/mixed state before refreeze and route to cutover instead of presenting `beacon change ... --refreeze-chain` as sufficient.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: After successful cutover, Beacon resumes the original operator intent, such as refreeze, without requiring the operator to rediscover the next command.
retained_requirement_surfaces.signature: ac::::resume-original-intent::after successful cutover, beacon resumes the original operator intent, such as refreeze, without requiring the operator to rediscover the next command.::

retained_requirement_surfaces.text: Cutover must detect stale installed/project skills or agent rules that still present old triptych as normal v1.5.2 truth authority and route to `doctor setup-agent-surface` / verify.

role_semantics.team_reviewer: checks implementation/spec drift before Ralph or QA closure
role_semantics.team_tester: checks implementation evidence and verification readiness before Ralph or QA closure
role_semantics.ralph: post-freeze controller that drives next-action routing across implementation, review, qa, and release

planner.purpose: Compile execution-ready task scope from the frozen revision baseline.

implementation-architect.purpose: Translate frozen requirement truth into implementation-safe module boundaries and service ownership guidance.

implementer.purpose: Write code inside the frozen scope and the implementation architecture note.

reviewer.purpose: Review implementation/spec drift and architecture-boundary drift.

tester.purpose: Check implementation evidence and verification readiness before acceptance.
